components.name: Primary Run Button
components.description: The compact accent action for running the current document.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height:24px; padding:3px 7px; border:0; border-radius:2px; background:#007acc; color:#fff; font:12px system-ui,sans-serif; transition:background 160ms ease,outline-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#198bd5; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:1px solid #9cdcfe; outline-offset:1px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background:#0066ab; }

components.name: Neutral Control
components.description: A compact secondary action used throughout panel headers and toolbars.
components.css: .ds-btn-neutral { height:24px; padding:3px 7px; border:1px solid rgba(157,157,157,.28); border-radius:2px; background:#1f1f1f; color:#cccccc; font:12px system-ui,sans-serif; transition:background 160ms ease,border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-neutral:hover { background:#264f78; } .ds-btn-neutral:focus-visible { outline:1px solid #007acc; outline-offset:1px; } .ds-btn-neutral:active { background:#007acc; color:#fff; }

components.name: Theme File Input
components.description: A compact native settings field for external theme and font paths.
components.css: .ds-input { height:24px; min-width:210px; padding:3px 7px; border:1px solid rgba(157,157,157,.28); border-radius:2px; background:#1e1e1e; color:#cccccc; font:13px system-ui,sans-serif; transition:border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-input:hover { border-color:#9d9d9d; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:0; border-color:#007acc; } .ds-input:disabled { color:#6f6f6f; }

components.name: Activity Rail Item
components.description: A custom-stroked 40×38px destination inside the fixed 48px rail.
components.html: <button class="ds-activity is-active" aria-label="Explorer"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="2" y="2" width="11" height="13" rx="1"/><rect x="7" y="5" width="11" height="13" rx="1"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-activity { width:40px; height:38px; display:grid; place-items:center; border:0; border-radius:2px; background:transparent; color:#9d9d9d; transition:background 160ms ease,color 160ms ease; } .ds-activity svg { width:20px; height:20px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.6; } .ds-activity:hover,.ds-activity.is-active { background:#264f78; color:#cccccc; } .ds-activity:focus-visible { outline:1px solid #007acc; outline-offset:-1px; }

components.name: Explorer File Row
components.description: A dense tree row with redundant disclosure and file/folder cues.
components.css: .ds-tree-row { width:100%; height:22px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:2px 4px; border:0; border-radius:2px; background:transparent; color:#cccccc; font:13px system-ui,sans-serif; text-align:left; transition:background 160ms ease; } .ds-tree-row svg { width:16px; height:18px; fill:none; stroke:#9d9d9d; stroke-width:1.2; } .ds-tree-row:hover { background:#264f78; } .ds-tree-row:focus-visible { outline:1px solid #007acc; }

components.name: Active Editor Tab
components.description: A flat active-file row with accent underline and explicit dirty state.
components.css: .ds-editor-tab { height:34px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:5px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(157,157,157,.20); background:#1f1f1f; color:#cccccc; font:12px system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-editor-tab strong { align-self:stretch; display:flex; align-items:center; border-bottom:2px solid #007acc; } .ds-editor-tab span,.ds-editor-tab small { color:#9d9d9d; font-size:11px; } .ds-editor-tab button { margin-left:auto; border:1px solid rgba(157,157,157,.28); border-radius:2px; background:#1f1f1f; color:#cccccc; } .ds-editor-tab button:hover { background:#264f78; } .ds-editor-tab button:focus-visible { outline:1px solid #007acc; }

components.description: The signature source-adjacent panel for live rendered mathematical output.

components.css: .ds-preview { min-width:280px; padding:7px 10px; border-left:1px solid rgba(157,157,157,.22); background:#1f1f1f; color:#cccccc; font:13px system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-preview header { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; } .ds-preview header strong { font-size:11px; } .ds-preview em { color:#007acc; font:normal 10.5px system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-preview button { margin-left:auto; border:1px solid rgba(157,157,157,.28); border-radius:2px; background:#1f1f1f; color:#cccccc; } .ds-preview button+button { margin-left:0; } .ds-preview button:hover { background:#264f78; } .ds-preview button:focus-visible { outline:1px solid #007acc; } .ds-preview-rule { margin-top:6px; border-top:1px solid rgba(157,157,157,.22); } .ds-preview article { padding-top:10px; } .ds-preview h3 { margin:0; font-size:15px; } .ds-preview small { color:#9d9d9d; } .ds-paper { margin-top:8px; padding:18px; background:#1e1e1e; text-align:center; font-family:serif; line-height:2.4; }

components.name: Output Dock Tabs
components.description: Compact OUTPUT and PROBLEMS tabs at the top of the resizable bottom dock.
components.css: .ds-dock-tabs { height:30px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:0 10px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(157,157,157,.22); background:#1e1e1e; } .ds-dock-tabs button { padding:3px 7px; border:0; border-radius:2px; background:transparent; color:#cccccc; font:600 11px system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-dock-tabs button:hover,.ds-dock-tabs .is-active { background:#264f78; } .ds-dock-tabs button:focus-visible { outline:1px solid #007acc; } .ds-dock-tabs .ds-copy { margin-left:auto; font-weight:400; }

components.name: Accent Status Bar
components.description: The 22px workspace anchor for run state, operation, encoding, cursor line, and diagnostics.
components.css: .ds-status { height:22px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:2px 8px; background:#007acc; color:#fff; font:11px system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-status strong { font-weight:700; } .ds-status-meta { margin-left:auto; } .ds-status:focus-within { outline:1px solid #9cdcfe; outline-offset:-1px; }

narrative.overview:
SCAS is a dense, native Operate-mode desktop IDE: familiar enough to trust immediately, quiet enough to keep source and rendered mathematics in focus. Its workspace topology follows established developer tools, while its restraint, sparse accent usage, and precise spacing take their cue from Zed. The visual system is functional, flat, and theme-led rather than branded through ornament.

The signature workflow is simultaneous source and live typeset output. Explorer, editor, preview, diagnostics, program output, and status remain visible as one connected instrument; the live mathematical preview is the product-specific focal surface, never a detached secondary destination. Twelve bundled developer themes share the same semantic TOML contract, with Dark Modern as the default, and external theme loading remains a first-class extension point.
keyCharacteristics: Dense, flat panels divided by quiet one-pixel structure.
Compact 11–13px interface chrome around a 15px code surface.
A stable IDE topology with collapsible and resizable supporting panes.
One theme accent reserved for selection, active state, live state, and status.
Custom vector icons drawn in a consistent 1.6px stroke language.
Source and rendered mathematics held in direct visual conversation.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Accent color communicates action or state; it is not ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Semantic Theme Rule
rules.body: Components consume named UI and syntax roles, never theme-specific color literals.

rules.name: The Chrome Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Routine interface chrome stays between 11px and 13px; 15–16px is reserved for code, rendered-document headings, and exceptional hierarchy.

rules.name: The Stable Topology Rule
rules.body: Resizing and collapsing redistribute work area but do not reorder navigation, source, preview, output, or status.

rules.name: The Flat Workspace Rule
rules.body: Persistent IDE panels never float; use tonal layers and separators, not card shadows.

dos: Do preserve the menu bar → activity rail/Explorer → editor/preview → output dock → status bar topology.
Do keep source and the live mathematical result visible together whenever width permits.
Do consume the shared TOML theme roles and preserve all twelve bundled themes plus external loading.
Do use one-pixel separators, 2px control corners, compact spacing, and the shared 160ms state motion.
Do pair color with text, shape, count, or position for dirty, live, run, selection, and diagnostic state.
donts: Don't turn persistent panels into rounded cards, add gradients, or introduce ambient workspace shadows.
Don't spend accent color on decoration or allow syntax colors to leak into general chrome.
Don't replace the custom vector family with emoji, icon fonts, or mixed stroke weights.
Don't hide live typeset output behind a separate workflow when a simultaneous preview can fit.
Don't enlarge routine chrome beyond the established 11–13px range or loosen the compact density without a platform accessibility reason.
